name: Cryogenic volumetric hydrogen adsorption isotherm in porous powder (ASAP 2020 application method)
plain_name: Measure hydrogen uptake by a porous storage material
description: Measure hydrogen uptake by a porous storage material. A bounded, source-grounded procedure profile; compatibility covers the listed checks and does not guarantee measured scientific performance.

sources.citation: Micromeritics Application Note 136: Using the ASAP 2020 for Determining the Hydrogen Adsorption Capacity of Powders and Porous Materials

reported_conditions.as_printed: Cryogenic bath: liquid nitrogen or liquid argon

requirements.rationale: Absolute-pressure hydrogen dosing and uptake analysis are essential. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.

Select the liquid-nitrogen implementation of the documented cryogenic method; liquid argon is a separate user choice. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.

missing_information: The application note requires the measured bath temperature to be entered; no exact specimen setpoint is claimed here.
Sample-specific degassing compatibility, mass, free-space correction, gas purity and the pressure table require confirmation. This profile is not a hydrogen-tank charging procedure.
confirmation_note: Profile author reviewed these exact sourced conditions on 2026-10-31. The application must still require the user's review/confirmation; all edits invalidate confirmation.
